input.commit: one identical event per fresh consumer group/projection
input.ack: same 20 healthy +5 ISR1 events per ACK level

interpretation.lastIsrLeaderAbsent: all topics leader=-1, ISR empty, ELR/lastKnownELR [1] while original leader absent; no forced unclean election
interpretation.recovery: restore original disk/broker; all healthy records plus ACK0/1 fault5 retained; all fault5 rejected
interpretation.productionDecision: keep auto=false, BATCH/syncCommit, acks=all/idempotence=true; HA requires RF3/minISR2 and ELR1

limitations: Single host process/container stop, not AZ or permanent disk loss
ACK comparison disables idempotence/retries for every level to isolate ACK policy; not production throughput comparison
ACK0 API success is not broker confirmation
No loss observed after original disk restored does not prove ACK1 durable against loss of its sole replica
AUTO_POLL_AHEAD deliberately violates DB-before-next-poll; synchronous AUTO cases had no missing event
No live source, no source gap reconstruction
First failed run exception type was recorded but not its operation/message; do not infer exact cause beyond last checkpoint
Last broker stopped with docker stop --timeout 0; absence observed for 15.048 seconds. replica lag limit 3s is compressed test configuration, not an operating recommendation.
